entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Thank you, Jane. I see the Urban Commuter Helmet here, delivered about 76 days ago. To proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. The color just isn't what I expected. Fine, I guess.
I understand. Let me just confirm our return policy for the item. One moment.
Sure. Take your time. I've got all day.
Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on this item within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at 76 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. Fine. What do I have to do? The box is unopened, if that helps you.

That's perfect, thank you. I have just initiated the return process and emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on your account. You can just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off. We want to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit gear, as your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
Absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day, Jane.
